description: Pins the audio-window capture schema for SFX sound-parity verification. Each entry holds a tic number, a SHA-256 hash of the mixed SFX PCM output buffer for that tic period (SAMPLES_PER_TIC = 1260 samples of signed 16-bit stereo at 44100 Hz), and the active channel count (0-8). Music output is tracked separately by the music-event-log format (02-014). Default sampling interval is 35 tics (one second).
scopeNote: SFX output mix only; music events are captured separately by 02-014.
